own_solution.law: t = (8 mu L A/(pi rho g r^4)) ln(h0/h1)
assumptions: Poiseuille flow at every depth (Re about 4 at most)
driving pressure rho g h only

notes: tau = 8*0.12*0.5*0.01/(pi*900*9.8*8.1e-11) = 2138.6 s. Base 2138.6*ln(1.6) = 1005.2 s = 16.753 min (claimed 16.7528). R values: h0 = 47 cm: ln(1.88)*tau = 1350.1 s = 22.501 min; 53 cm: ln(2.12)*tau = 1607.0 s = 26.784 min; 61 cm: ln(2.44)*tau = 1907.7 s = 31.794 min; all match the claims. Minimal pairs hold: T7B4A vs T3C55 differ only tank -> bucket with the same number, unit and tense; TFF4D vs TD265 differ only 'Just before the draining started' -> 'In an earlier experiment' with the same number and unit. T75EB and T7A3F are declared numeral-free twins, which resolves my pass-1 note that they carry no number; this is by design, not a rendering defect. Pass 1 answers were in seconds; the authors' target unit is minutes and the values agree. The question gives no unit, so either is acceptable.
